detail: T-84 removed the Drizzle schema from the browser bundle. One edge caused it: a client component imported lib-shipment-queue, which took a runtime value import of shipmentStatuses from db-schema, shipping the whole table graph in a 79 KB chunk. The literals moved to lib-domain-enums, a module with no runtime edge, and the schema re-exports them so no server importer changed. Client JavaScript fell from 1732044 to 1657092 bytes with no schema marker left in any chunk. The durable part is an import-graph guard that walks every use-client entry through imports, re-exports, dynamic imports and requires, stopping at use-server boundaries, and reports the offending path. Two review rounds broke earlier versions of that guard with ordinary ESM constructs; every evasion was reproduced and now fails it. Evidence: tsc, lint, build, 75 files and 569 integration tests
head: 67beb92e4135da15afc7357d905a4473f7e17020
